feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 September 2026 11:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 12 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to north of Scotland will move away, with a ridge of high pressure building into the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 this afternoon, then veering West or Northwest 3 or 4 this evening. Becoming Variable or Southeast 2 or 3 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate this afternoon, slight in the evening and then smooth or slight tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable or Southeast 2 or 3, settling South or Southwest 3 or 4 later tomorrow, increasing 4 or 5 on Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate on Monday morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then mist and fog patches developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling or very poor in mist and fog patches.
